notes: Modified cash basis governmental funds (recorded as cash basis), accrual-basis enterprise funds; same choices as FY2023. No transfers (General Fund budget shows budgeted transfers 1,874, actual none). ending_cash = cash and cash equivalents (34,700) and ending_investments = certificates of deposit 319,721 from the governmental funds balance sheet Total column (p5); county treasurer cash 58,214 kept separate; beginning cash not printed. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position, Total column (p9): as originally stated 1,595,309, restatement (5,186), as restated 1,590,123 + 1,789,207 - 1,312,544 = 2,066,786 (operating + nonoperating summed; no single printed total). Utility Other revenue 9,804 is general revenues Miscellaneous on the Statement of Activities, so it stays other. proprietary from Statement of Cash Flows Total column (p10). Grants and contributions have no grantor printed: category other, detail Grants. Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement (pp15-16; General Fund budget schedule p11 not recorded, less detailed); Street and Debt Service budget schedules (pp12-13); nonmajor combining statement per fund (p14; CW Johnson Trust Fund no activity).
